title: circuit-backed-deployment-matrix-with-proximity-priority-and-quantile-sla-gating
creator: Maya Chen
description: Goal: Implement a deployment control plane that synthesizes a 'deployment matrix' combining a circuit-breaker model (probing availability and health), proximity-priority routing (favoring local/low-latency replicas), and quantile-based SLA gating (p50/p95/p99 triggers). This ticket covers the runtime-side policy engine, lightweight compatibility checks for variant switching, and the orchestration hooks for A/B, shadowing, and auto-rollback decisions. The matrix should support: 1) staged mirroring (sampled shadow traffic to new variant at 0.5%-10%), 2) canary ramp with semantic regression checks using a small prompt set, 3) cost-tier awareness so fallbacks prefer cheaper compatible variants under capacity pressure, and 4) region failover rules that preserve geographic compliance and minimize cross-region tail-latency. This work focuses on the policy DSL, runtime enforcement points, and telemetry signals required to make safe automatic rollbacks and tiered degradations possible.
acceptance_criteria: 1) New policy DSL unit tests covering at least five routing scenarios (local priority, congested local, variant-incompatible, semantic-regression, cost-triggered-fallback). 2) End-to-end canary flow demo: 1% mirrored traffic, 5% canary ramp, auto-rollback triggered on semantic-score drop >= 3 points OR p99 latency increase > 30% OR error-rate increase > 2x within 10m. 3) Dashboards show per-variant p50/p95/p99, semantic-regression score, token-cost delta, and rollback events. 4) Integration tests with Dedicated and Private deployment lanes verifying region-tag respect and KMS-protected audit logs for every rollout decision.
rollout_steps: 1) Add policy DSL primitives: proximity_priority, circuit_thresholds, semantic_gate
2) Implement runtime evaluator that computes a deployment score per request path
3) Wire sampled shadowing hook to evaluation pipeline and store samples for offline eval
4) Add canary controller to orchestrate ramp percentages and evaluate gates every 60s
5) Build automatic rollback operator that applies rollback when composite score crosses fail threshold
6) Create dashboards/alerts and run internal dogfood rollout on staging before prod
test_plan: Unit tests for DSL and evaluator, synthetic traffic tests with regional latency emulation (us-east, eu-west, ap-south), semantic regression harness using 200 prompt golden set (approx 50 diverse prompts per vertical), load test for tiered-fallback under capacity exhaustion (simulate Dedicated pool saturation). Create a PR with test artifacts and link to runtime perf job results. Manual QA: run canary on staging + validate rollback path fires and audit entry is created.
